item.title: Ask HN: How are front end friends doing these days?
item.summary: With the popularity of AI tools, how are front-end folks doing? BG: My company recently laid off a group of people, most of them from R&D, and among R&D, most were front-end. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49356122 Points: 1 # Comments: 5
